5th Grade · Theme 2 · Classroom Life

Vocabulary Quiz

Test 1 / 3
Cevaplanan: 0 / 50

Doğru şıkkı işaretle. Cevabını değiştirebilirsin. Bitirince altta TESTİ BİTİR düğmesine bas. Menü ile başka bir teste geçebilirsin.

1Vocabulary Test 1 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Ece brings paints and brushes to school. She draws pictures and uses many colours in this lesson. Her favourite subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) art

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ece brings paints and brushes to school. She draws pictures and uses many colours in this lesson.” Bu tarif “art” kelimesine uyar; art = görsel sanatlar. Diğer şıklar: P.E. (beden eğitimi), music (müzik), Social Studies (sosyal bilgiler).

2

Mert enjoys working with numbers. He adds, subtracts and solves number problems in this lesson. His favourite subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) maths

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mert enjoys working with numbers. He adds, subtracts and solves number problems in this lesson.” Bu tarif “maths” kelimesine uyar; maths = matematik. Diğer şıklar: ruler (cetvel), clock (duvar saati), lend (ödünç vermek).

3

Selin learns about plants, animals and light. Her class also does experiments. This subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) science

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Selin learns about plants, animals and light. Her class also does experiments.” Bu tarif “science” kelimesine uyar; science = fen bilimleri. Diğer şıklar: English (İngilizce), I.T. (bilişim teknolojileri), Social Studies (sosyal bilgiler).

4

Bora puts on his sports shoes. His class runs, jumps and plays games in this lesson. This subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) P.E.

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Bora puts on his sports shoes. His class runs, jumps and plays games in this lesson.” Bu tarif “P.E.” kelimesine uyar; P.E. = beden eğitimi. Diğer şıklar: bookcase (kitaplık), poster (afiş), morning (sabah).

5

Duru sings with her classmates. They learn songs and play instruments in this lesson. Their subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) music

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Duru sings with her classmates. They learn songs and play instruments in this lesson.” Bu tarif “music” kelimesine uyar; music = müzik. Diğer şıklar: maths (matematik), science (fen bilimleri), art (görsel sanatlar).

6

Arda uses a computer in this lesson. He learns about keyboards and computer programs. This subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) I.T.

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda uses a computer in this lesson. He learns about keyboards and computer programs.” Bu tarif “I.T.” kelimesine uyar; I.T. = bilişim teknolojileri. Diğer şıklar: rubbish bin (çöp kutusu), afternoon (öğleden sonra), Monday (Pazartesi).

7

Elif learns about society and the places where people live. Her teacher also talks about history and maps. This subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) Social Studies

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Elif learns about society and the places where people live. Her teacher also talks about history and maps.” Bu tarif “Social Studies” kelimesine uyar; Social Studies = sosyal bilgiler. Diğer şıklar: art (görsel sanatlar), maths (matematik), music (müzik).

8

Can learns to say hello and goodbye. He practises reading and speaking in this language lesson. This subject is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) English

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Can learns to say hello and goodbye. He practises reading and speaking in this language lesson.” Bu tarif “English” kelimesine uyar; English = İngilizce. Diğer şıklar: P.E. (beden eğitimi), I.T. (bilişim teknolojileri), science (fen bilimleri).

9

Nehir does not know an English word. She checks a book that explains words and their meanings. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) dictionary

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir does not know an English word. She checks a book that explains words and their meanings.” Bu tarif “dictionary” kelimesine uyar; dictionary = sözlük. Diğer şıklar: crayon (pastel boya), glue (yapıştırıcı), rubber (silgi).

10

Emir needs a straight line in his notebook. He uses a long object with centimetre marks. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) ruler

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Emir needs a straight line in his notebook. He uses a long object with centimetre marks.” Bu tarif “ruler” kelimesine uyar; ruler = cetvel. Diğer şıklar: notebook (defter), school bag (okul çantası), bookshelf (kitap rafı).

11

Sena wants two small pieces of paper. She uses a tool with two blades to cut the paper. She needs ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) scissors

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena wants two small pieces of paper. She uses a tool with two blades to cut the paper.” Bu tarif “scissors” kelimesine uyar; scissors = makas. Diğer şıklar: board marker (tahta kalemi), smart board (akıllı tahta), pencil case (kalem kutusu).

12

Baran makes a paper card. He needs something sticky to attach a picture to it. He uses ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) glue

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran makes a paper card. He needs something sticky to attach a picture to it.” Bu tarif “glue” kelimesine uyar; glue = yapıştırıcı. Diğer şıklar: desk (sıra, masa), clock (duvar saati), notebook (defter).

13

İpek makes a mistake with her pencil. She removes the pencil mark from the page. She uses a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) rubber

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek makes a mistake with her pencil. She removes the pencil mark from the page.” Bu tarif “rubber” kelimesine uyar; rubber = silgi. Diğer şıklar: bookcase (kitaplık), scissors (makas), bookshelf (kitap rafı).

14

Tolga keeps his pens and pencils together. He puts them in a small container inside his bag. It is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) pencil case

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga keeps his pens and pencils together. He puts them in a small container inside his bag.” Bu tarif “pencil case” kelimesine uyar; pencil case = kalem kutusu. Diğer şıklar: board marker (tahta kalemi), poster (afiş), school bag (okul çantası).

15

Eylül wants to know the time. She looks at the round object on the classroom wall. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) clock

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül wants to know the time. She looks at the round object on the classroom wall.” Bu tarif “clock” kelimesine uyar; clock = duvar saati. Diğer şıklar: desk (sıra, masa), crayon (pastel boya), rubbish bin (çöp kutusu).

16

Ozan's teacher shows a video to the class. She touches a large electronic classroom screen. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) smart board

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan's teacher shows a video to the class. She touches a large electronic classroom screen.” Bu tarif “smart board” kelimesine uyar; smart board = akıllı tahta. Diğer şıklar: dictionary (sözlük), poster (afiş), glue (yapıştırıcı).

17

Cemre writes her lesson notes on lined pages. She keeps all the pages together in one small book. It is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) notebook

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cemre writes her lesson notes on lined pages. She keeps all the pages together in one small book.” Bu tarif “notebook” kelimesine uyar; notebook = defter. Diğer şıklar: bookcase (kitaplık), desk (sıra, masa), pencil case (kalem kutusu).

18

Yusuf finishes a snack. He puts the empty wrapper in the correct container. This container is the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) rubbish bin

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Yusuf finishes a snack. He puts the empty wrapper in the correct container.” Bu tarif “rubbish bin” kelimesine uyar; rubbish bin = çöp kutusu. Diğer şıklar: ruler (cetvel), crayon (pastel boya), school bag (okul çantası).

19

Melis puts her books on a long flat surface. It is fixed to the wall and holds the books in a row. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) bookshelf

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Melis puts her books on a long flat surface. It is fixed to the wall and holds the books in a row.” Bu tarif “bookshelf” kelimesine uyar; bookshelf = kitap rafı. Diğer şıklar: scissors (makas), dictionary (sözlük), rubber (silgi).

20

Aras writes a word on the whiteboard. He uses a special pen for this surface. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) board marker

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aras writes a word on the whiteboard. He uses a special pen for this surface.” Bu tarif “board marker” kelimesine uyar; board marker = tahta kalemi. Diğer şıklar: smart board (akıllı tahta), desk (sıra, masa), ruler (cetvel).

21

Sıla colours a picture. She uses a coloured wax stick instead of a pencil. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) crayon

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sıla colours a picture. She uses a coloured wax stick instead of a pencil.” Bu tarif “crayon” kelimesine uyar; crayon = pastel boya. Diğer şıklar: bookcase (kitaplık), clock (duvar saati), scissors (makas).

22

Gökçe takes her books to school. She carries them in a bag on her back. It is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) school bag

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Gökçe takes her books to school. She carries them in a bag on her back.” Bu tarif “school bag” kelimesine uyar; school bag = okul çantası. Diğer şıklar: rubber (silgi), board marker (tahta kalemi), glue (yapıştırıcı).

23

Defne sees a large printed picture on the wall. It has a message about keeping the classroom clean. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) poster

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Defne sees a large printed picture on the wall. It has a message about keeping the classroom clean.” Bu tarif “poster” kelimesine uyar; poster = afiş. Diğer şıklar: smart board (akıllı tahta), pencil case (kalem kutusu), rubbish bin (çöp kutusu).

24

Kerem has a tall piece of furniture in his room. It has several shelves full of books. It is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) bookcase

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Kerem has a tall piece of furniture in his room. It has several shelves full of books.” Bu tarif “bookcase” kelimesine uyar; bookcase = kitaplık. Diğer şıklar: notebook (defter), dictionary (sözlük), school bag (okul çantası).

25

Buse sits down for her lesson. She puts her notebook on the table in front of her. This table is her ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) desk

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Buse sits down for her lesson. She puts her notebook on the table in front of her.” Bu tarif “desk” kelimesine uyar; desk = sıra, masa. Diğer şıklar: bookshelf (kitap rafı), clock (duvar saati), ruler (cetvel).

2Vocabulary Test 2 · Read each paragraph. Choose the correct word to complete the blank.

1

Our school week starts after Sunday. We have our first lessons of the week on this day. It is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Monday

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Our school week starts after Sunday. We have our first lessons of the week on this day.” Bu tarif “Monday” kelimesine uyar; Monday = Pazartesi. Diğer şıklar: timetable (ders programı), Sunday (Pazar), quarter past (çeyrek geçe).

2

Deniz has art the day after Tuesday. His next school day is Thursday. He has art on ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) Wednesday

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Deniz has art the day after Tuesday. His next school day is Thursday.” Bu tarif “Wednesday” kelimesine uyar; Wednesday = Çarşamba. Diğer şıklar: morning (sabah), afternoon (öğleden sonra), weekend (hafta sonu).

3

İdil has music on the last day of the school week. The next day is Saturday. She has music on ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) Friday

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İdil has music on the last day of the school week. The next day is Saturday.” Bu tarif “Friday” kelimesine uyar; Friday = Cuma. Diğer şıklar: quarter to (çeyrek kala), half past (buçuk), break (teneffüs, ara).

4

Onur rests on the day after Saturday. The following day is Monday and school starts again. Today is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) Sunday

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Onur rests on the day after Saturday. The following day is Monday and school starts again.” Bu tarif “Sunday” kelimesine uyar; Sunday = Pazar. Diğer şıklar: noon (öğle vakti), timetable (ders programı), Wednesday (Çarşamba).

5

Zeynep has no school on Saturday or Sunday. She spends these two days with her family. These days form the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) weekend

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Zeynep has no school on Saturday or Sunday. She spends these two days with her family.” Bu tarif “weekend” kelimesine uyar; weekend = hafta sonu. Diğer şıklar: break (teneffüs, ara), half past (buçuk), Monday (Pazartesi).

6

Arda gets up at seven. He eats breakfast before he goes to school. He does these things in the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) morning

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Arda gets up at seven. He eats breakfast before he goes to school.” Bu tarif “morning” kelimesine uyar; morning = sabah. Diğer şıklar: quarter past (çeyrek geçe), quarter to (çeyrek kala), Friday (Cuma).

7

Mina finishes lunch at one. Her next lesson starts at two and ends before evening. It takes place in the ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) afternoon

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Mina finishes lunch at one. Her next lesson starts at two and ends before evening.” Bu tarif “afternoon” kelimesine uyar; afternoon = öğleden sonra. Diğer şıklar: weekend (hafta sonu), Sunday (Pazar), break (teneffüs, ara).

8

Ali looks at the time. It is exactly twelve in the middle of the day. It is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) noon

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ali looks at the time. It is exactly twelve in the middle of the day.” Bu tarif “noon” kelimesine uyar; noon = öğle vakti. Diğer şıklar: timetable (ders programı), quarter to (çeyrek kala), Friday (Cuma).

9

Pelin's lesson begins at 9:30. It is thirty minutes after nine. We say ______ nine.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) half past

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Pelin's lesson begins at 9:30. It is thirty minutes after nine.” Bu tarif “half past” kelimesine uyar; half past = buçuk. Diğer şıklar: Monday (Pazartesi), Wednesday (Çarşamba), afternoon (öğleden sonra).

10

Efe has a break at 10:15. It is fifteen minutes after ten. We say ______ ten.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) quarter past

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Efe has a break at 10:15. It is fifteen minutes after ten.” Bu tarif “quarter past” kelimesine uyar; quarter past = çeyrek geçe. Diğer şıklar: noon (öğle vakti), morning (sabah), Friday (Cuma).

11

Derya leaves home at 8:45. It is fifteen minutes before nine. We say ______ nine.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) quarter to

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Derya leaves home at 8:45. It is fifteen minutes before nine.” Bu tarif “quarter to” kelimesine uyar; quarter to = çeyrek kala. Diğer şıklar: half past (buçuk), Monday (Pazartesi), afternoon (öğleden sonra).

12

Berk wants to know his lessons for each day. He checks a chart with the subjects and lesson times. This chart is his ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) timetable

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Berk wants to know his lessons for each day. He checks a chart with the subjects and lesson times.” Bu tarif “timetable” kelimesine uyar; timetable = ders programı. Diğer şıklar: morning (sabah), noon (öğle vakti), quarter past (çeyrek geçe).

13

Sena has a short rest between two lessons. She talks to her friends before the next class starts. This time is a ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) break

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Sena has a short rest between two lessons. She talks to her friends before the next class starts.” Bu tarif “break” kelimesine uyar; break = teneffüs, ara. Diğer şıklar: weekend (hafta sonu), Sunday (Pazar), Wednesday (Çarşamba).

14

Burak needs a pencil for one lesson. His friend gives him one, and he returns it after class. He asks to ______ a pencil.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) borrow

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Burak needs a pencil for one lesson. His friend gives him one, and he returns it after class.” Bu tarif “borrow” kelimesine uyar; borrow = ödünç almak. Diğer şıklar: follow (takip etmek, uymak), leave (bırakmak, ayrılmak), hold on (beklemek, tutunmak).

15

Eda has two rulers. She gives one to her friend for the lesson and gets it back later. She agrees to ______ her ruler.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) lend

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eda has two rulers. She gives one to her friend for the lesson and gets it back later.” Bu tarif “lend” kelimesine uyar; lend = ödünç vermek. Diğer şıklar: give a hand (yardım etmek), forget (unutmak), finish (bitirmek).

16

Tuna knows the answer in class. He lifts one hand and waits for the teacher. The teacher asks students to ______ before speaking.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) raise your hand

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tuna knows the answer in class. He lifts one hand and waits for the teacher.” Bu tarif “raise your hand” kelimesine uyar; raise your hand = elini kaldırmak. Diğer şıklar: work in groups (gruplar hâlinde çalışmak), show respect (saygı göstermek), bring (getirmek).

17

Cem sees a new word in a story. He opens his dictionary to find its meaning. He wants to ______ the word.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) look up

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Cem sees a new word in a story. He opens his dictionary to find its meaning.” Bu tarif “look up” kelimesine uyar; look up = sözlükte kelime aramak. Diğer şıklar: hang (asmak), throw rubbish (çöp atmak), keep clean (temiz tutmak).

18

Aylin's desk has pens and books everywhere. She puts each thing in its correct place. She decides to ______ her desk.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) tidy up

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Aylin's desk has pens and books everywhere. She puts each thing in its correct place.” Bu tarif “tidy up” kelimesine uyar; tidy up = toparlamak, düzenlemek. Diğer şıklar: follow (takip etmek, uymak), forget (unutmak), borrow (ödünç almak).

19

Eren's teacher gives four students one project. They share the tasks and complete it together. They ______ during the lesson.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) work in groups

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eren's teacher gives four students one project. They share the tasks and complete it together.” Bu tarif “work in groups” kelimesine uyar; work in groups = gruplar hâlinde çalışmak. Diğer şıklar: keep clean (temiz tutmak), hang (asmak), raise your hand (elini kaldırmak).

20

Nehir's teacher explains a difficult task. The students need to hear every word and understand it. They must ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) listen carefully

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Nehir's teacher explains a difficult task. The students need to hear every word and understand it.” Bu tarif “listen carefully” kelimesine uyar; listen carefully = dikkatlice dinlemek. Diğer şıklar: leave (bırakmak, ayrılmak), throw rubbish (çöp atmak), bring (getirmek).

21

Baran cannot carry all his books. His friend offers to help him with them. His friend wants to ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) give a hand

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Baran cannot carry all his books. His friend offers to help him with them.” Bu tarif “give a hand” kelimesine uyar; give a hand = yardım etmek. Diğer şıklar: finish (bitirmek), look up (sözlükte kelime aramak), tidy up (toparlamak, düzenlemek).

22

İpek and her friends share a project. Each person does a different task, and they help one another. This is good ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) teamwork

Paragraftaki ipucu: “İpek and her friends share a project. Each person does a different task, and they help one another.” Bu tarif “teamwork” kelimesine uyar; teamwork = takım çalışması. Diğer şıklar: rubbish bin (çöp kutusu), bookshelf (kitap rafı), board marker (tahta kalemi).

23

Tolga is in the library. He speaks in a very low voice so others can read. He speaks ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) quietly

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Tolga is in the library. He speaks in a very low voice so others can read.” Bu tarif “quietly” kelimesine uyar; quietly = sessizce. Diğer şıklar: smart board (akıllı tahta), music (müzik), scissors (makas).

24

Eylül loves horses. She sits on a horse and controls it as it moves. Her hobby is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) horseback riding

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Eylül loves horses. She sits on a horse and controls it as it moves.” Bu tarif “horseback riding” kelimesine uyar; horseback riding = at binme. Diğer şıklar: P.E. (beden eğitimi), science (fen bilimleri), glue (yapıştırıcı).

25

Ozan enjoys a sport with two people on a mat. Each person tries to bring the other to the ground without punching. This sport is ______.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) wrestling

Paragraftaki ipucu: “Ozan enjoys a sport with two people on a mat. Each person tries to bring the other to the ground without punching.” Bu tarif “wrestling” kelimesine uyar; wrestling = güreş. Diğer şıklar: poster (afiş), ruler (cetvel), pencil case (kalem kutusu).

3Vocabulary Quiz 50 · Choose the correct Turkish meaning of each word. (Her kelimenin doğru Türkçe anlamını seçiniz.)

1

art

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) görsel sanatlar

“art” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “görsel sanatlar” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We draw pictures in art lessons.

2

maths

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) matematik

“maths” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “matematik” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: Maths is my favourite lesson.

3

science

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: D) fen bilimleri

“science” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “fen bilimleri” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We do experiments in science.

4

P.E.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) beden eğitimi

“P.E.” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “beden eğitimi” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We play basketball in P.E.

5

music

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: C) müzik

“music” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “müzik” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We sing songs in music lessons.

6

I.T.

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: A) bilişim teknolojileri

“I.T.” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “bilişim teknolojileri” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We use computers in I.T.

7

Social Studies

💡 ÇözümDoğru cevap: B) sosyal bilgiler

“Social Studies” ifadesinin Türkçe anlamı “sosyal bilgiler” olur. Bu ifade “Okul dersleri” grubundandır. Örnek: We learn about history in Social Studies.

8
